note: Suggested labels from the v3 visual pass (docs/SPRITE-ANATOMY.md), keyed like the local label tool.

normal:0,0.notes: standing, one hand on hip, other arm down, neutral face — true rest | family base

normal:1,0.notes: fist forward, neutral — about to make a point | vs 8,1: arm redrawn + faint cheek pixels

normal:2,0.notes: fist forward, frowning — objecting, stern | vs 8,1: mouth corners turn down

normal:3,0.notes: arms folded over belly, head turned aside — calm waiting | family base

normal:4,0.notes: arm across, hand to chin — thinking | family base

normal:5,0.notes: hand to chin, eyes narrowed — concentrating (also the blink frame of 4,0) | vs 4,0: pupils flatten to a 3px lid line = eyes narrowed / half-blink

normal:6,0.notes: hand to chin, glancing aside — pondering, reading | vs 4,0: pupils shift down-aside

normal:7,0.notes: hand to chin, alternate drawing — thinking | vs 4,0: body variant (arm/hair redrawn, ~90px)

normal:8,0.notes: hands clasped in front, neutral — polite waiting | family base

normal:9,0.notes: arms crossed, hand at chin, neutral — weighing it up | family base

normal:10,0.notes: arms crossed, eyes narrowed — skeptical focus (also the blink frame of 9,0) | vs 9,0: pupils flatten = eyes narrowed / half-blink

normal:11,0.notes: hand to chin, alternate drawing — thinking | vs 4,0: body variant (~100px)

normal:0,1.notes: thumbs up, neutral face — approval | family base

normal:1,1.notes: thumb raised high — anticipation before the thumbs up | vs 0,1: thumb raised high by the face (arm redrawn)

normal:2,1.notes: thumbs up with grin and wink — strong success | vs 0,1: wide grin + right eye half-closed (wink)

normal:3,1.notes: thumbs up follow-through, grin and wink — success settle | vs 0,1: grin + wink + thumb lowered

normal:4,1.notes: open-arm shrug, palms up, neutral — unsure | family base

normal:5,1.notes: big shrug, eyebrow up, looking away — "no idea" | vs 4,1: arms higher + brow raised + glance aside

normal:6,1.notes: both hands on hips, small smile — proud, ready | family base

normal:7,1.notes: fist forward with a knowing half-wink — "got it" | vs 8,1: arm redrawn + one eye half-closed + brow

normal:8,1.notes: fist forward, mouth closed with right corner up — making a point (lip-sync rest) | family base

normal:9,1.notes: fist forward, mouth open — speaking (lip-sync open) | vs 8,1: mouth fully open: row of teeth

normal:10,1.notes: fist forward, open grin with narrowed eyes — emphatic, amused while talking | vs 8,1: mouth open + eyes narrowed

normal:11,1.notes: fist forward, eyebrow raised, looking up — skeptical "hmm?" | vs 8,1: brow raised + pupils up + mouth corner

normal:0,2.notes: leans back, teeth gritted, glasses flash — startled recoil | family base

normal:1,2.notes: leans back, eyes squeezed, teeth gritted — wince, "ouch" | vs 0,2: eyes squeezed shut

normal:2,2.notes: slumped, fists down, frown, glasses glare hide the eyes — dejected | family base

normal:3,2.notes: slumped, lip quivering — about to cry, hard error | vs 2,2: lip quiver pixels at the mouth corner

normal:4,2.notes: arms crossed, brow furrowed — concerned (subtle) | vs 9,0: 2px brow furrow between the lenses + mouth corner drops

normal:5,2.notes: hands held at belly, one brow pixel raised — attentive listening | family base

normal:6,2.notes: fist forward, winking — playful "you got it" | vs 8,1: arm redrawn + one eye closed

normal:7,2.notes: hand raised by the head — wave / hello | family base

normal:0,3.notes: tugging the collar, nervous toothy grin — nervous, sheepish | family base

normal:1,3.notes: fist forward, mouth slightly open — speaking (lip-sync mid) | vs 8,1: mouth opens: 2px teeth

normal:2,3.notes: bent forward holding belly, one eye shut, mouth open — laughing | family base

normal:3,3.notes: laughing harder — bounce low | vs 2,3: head dips lower, mouth wider

normal:4,3.notes: laughing — bounce up | vs 2,3: head tilts back up

normal:5,3.notes: collar tug + blush — embarrassed | vs 0,3: blush + brow pixels + grin widens

normal:6,3.notes: hands clasped + blush + smile — flattered, thankful | vs 8,0: blush + smile

normal:7,3.notes: rest pose + blush + smile — pleased, warm | vs 0,0: cheeks blush (2 rows), mouth drops 1px and curls up = smile

normal:8,3.notes: rest pose + blush + smile, glancing away — shy, flattered | vs 0,0: blush + smile + pupils shifted aside = looks away

normal:9,3.notes: collar tug, face drained pale — mortified / chilled | vs 0,3: whole face turns pale blue-green

normal:10,3.notes: a spectral skull appears beside him, teeth gritted — fright | family base
